auditOfA.note: Every bank id A cited is in the served list and every card id is in the published deck. Each was read in full. ownSearchBeforeA.note: B reached the same 27 / 14 / 9 split before opening A; the verdicts agree on all 50.

final.rule: Covered only if both A and B say covered; B's skill, off-syllabus and dropped labels win.

openCallsSettled.Q243 (n8): Covered. Cards fact-all-inclusive and fact-roots-of-success tie the Congress success to its national-movement, all-inclusive nature; every distractor is a fact taught elsewhere about the Jana Sangh or is false.
openCallsSettled.Q249 (n14): Not covered although solvable by elimination (A, B known true, C known to be the Second Plan): statement D (push savings up) is taught nowhere, and the strict rule needs every statement.
openCallsSettled.Q260, Q264, Q269, Q273 (n25, n29, n34, n: Not covered although three of four pairs are taught in n25, n29, n38: a match item needs every pair (METHOD step 5).
openCallsSettled.Q252 (n17): Covered. NCERT dates the Chemical Weapons Convention 1997 (card fact-bwc-cwc); the order C, D, A, B holds with either 1993 or 1997.
openCallsSettled.Q267 (n32): Covered. NCERT names K. Kamraj as the Syndicate leader (card list-syndicate-members), which makes statement A false as keyed.
openCallsSettled.Q285 (n50): Countable, not skill: the passage names no 1997 Prime Minister. Not covered.
